# orion history

A canvas's revisions, and jumping between them

```sh
orion history <command> [options]
```

## orion history list

List the revisions you can jump to, newest first, with when and how each was made

```sh
orion history list [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion history set

Jump the canvas to a saved revision, as a new revision, so later ones stay in the list

```sh
orion history set [revision] [options]
```

| Argument                | Description                                             |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[revision]`            | The revision to jump to, as orion history list shows it |
| `--dry-run`             | Preview what would change without writing               |
| `--if-revision <value>` | Write only if the document has this revision            |
| `--json`                | Print JSON                                              |
